newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: BRIEFING ON HAVEL'S LUNG SURGERY AT 1400 CET.
newsitem.headline: BRIEFING ON HAVEL'S LUNG SURGERY AT 1400 CET.

text.p: A briefing to discuss the lung surgery performed on Monday on Czech President Vaclav Havel has been scheduled for 1400 local time (1300 gmt), his spokesman said in a statement.
The expected duration of the surgery, to remove a spot from Havel's lung, has not been announced.
Dr. Pavel Pafko, chief surgeon at the Third Surgery Clinic in central Prague who is leading the operation, will conduct the briefing.
On Sunday, the former dissident playwright said in a radio interview that his health was not in serious danger.
Havel, a heavy smoker, has been ill for several weeks with an ailment first diagnosed as pneumonia.
